# MDN031 `include-statement`

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="info" text="opt-in" />

A Fortran `include` line.

## Why

`include` pastes text: the included declarations are compiled again in every includer, and nothing
checks they stay consistent. A module provides the same entities once, with explicit interfaces.

## Reported

```fortran
include 'constants.inc'
```

## Preferred

```fortran
use constants, only: pi
```

## Suppressing

For one occurrence, with the reason on the same line (or alone on the line before the statement):

```fortran
! fobis: ignore[MDN031] <why this occurrence is fine>
```

For the whole project, `ignore = MDN031` in the fobos [`[lint]` section](/cookbook/analysis#choose-the-rules).

## Equivalent

Fortitude rule `MOD031` (see [Lint Rules](/lint-rules/#relation-to-fortitude)).
